map.基本尺寸 50mm、配合 H7/g6：IT7=25μm，孔 0/+25μm；轴: Basic size 50mm, fit H7/g6: IT7=25μm, hole 0/+25μm; shaft g6 es=−9μm, ei=−9−16=−25μm (IT6=16); max clearance=25−(−25)=50μm=0.050mm, min clearance=0−(−9)=9μm=0.009mm → clearance fit (max 0.050, min 0.009mm).
map.小间隙滑动配合，用于需自由转动或对中、又要求一定定心的轴孔，如滑块、导柱；最大间: A small-clearance sliding fit for shafts needing free rotation or alignment yet some centering, e.g. sliders, guide posts; max 0.05mm clearance at 50mm size is a precision clearance.

map.IT 越小精度越高、制造越难越贵；IT7 为常用配合精度，IT6 更精密；选配合: Smaller IT means higher precision, harder and costlier to make; IT7 is common fit precision, IT6 finer; choose fit balancing function and cost — over-pursuing precision greatly raises machining cost.
